description: Failover (F), redistribution (R) and autoscale (A) phases of the large audio mesh, each group one held step of listeners on curve 1 (five edges a region). Every scenario: a baseline, the fault at baseline_s, an observation, the restore, a settle. A kill is SIGKILL and then the unit stopped (Restart=always would bring it back in 2 s; low-latency ops D4); a crash is the SIGKILL alone, the 2 s restart (F2r). Fault sizes against five serving edges a region: at most 2 of 5 at once (D5). LL-HLS readers are needletail-reader crowds that follow steering and move; their entry points and the liveness check are nodes that no phase faults. scale-run.py run --phase-plan deploy/low-latency/phases-scale.json --group F|R|A. needs_am names the Phase AM items a scenario waits for before it can pass; until then it runs and measures what the current binaries do (for example the pile-up when needletail-load moves to the next edge of its list). deploy/low-latency/SCALE.md has the cost, the shedding order and the local proofs.

shedding: Drop the scenario of the lowest `shed` first when the run's projected end passes 5.75 h of the lab's life (the watchdog deletes it at 6.0 h): F8, R5, then curve 1's c1-opus1-mixed (SCALE.md), F2r, R4, F7, ... ; 0 is not run until its Phase AM work lands.
